subject: general
question: When passing stationary vehicles, keep a watch on ___________ who may come out suddenly from the front of the stationary vehicle. While overtaking, it should be done on the __________ side. Always keep a good _________________ between your vehicle and others.
solution:
The correct answer is __pedestrians; right; distance __

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When passing stationary vehicles, always watch for pedestrians__ who may suddenly come out from the front of the vehicle.
 
• Overtaking should be performed from the __right side__ of the vehicle.
 
• It is important to maintain a __good distance__ between your vehicle and others to ensure safety.
 
• Keeping a safe distance helps __avoid sudden collisions__ and gives time to react.
 
• Always be vigilant and drive __defensively__ to prevent accidents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Driving Safely:**

 
 
• Always check your mirrors and blind spots before overtaking or changing lanes.
 
• Follow traffic rules and drive within the speed limits.
 
 
 
• **Pedestrian Safety:**
 
 
• Be cautious in areas with heavy pedestrian traffic, such as schools and markets.
 
• Watch out for crosswalks and always give way to pedestrians.
 
 
 
• **Vehicle Maintenance:**
 
 
• Ensure your vehicle is in good condition, including brakes, lights, and mirrors.
 
• Regular servicing and maintenance can prevent unexpected breakdowns.
